title: Sample: a short checklist for moving off Opsgenie
description: Sample post for local development (hidden from search): the steps to move on-call alerts before Opsgenie support ends.
tldr: List every alert that pages someone today.
Move the urgent ones first and test each with a real phone.
Switch off the old tool only after a quiet week.
markdown:
Opsgenie support ends on 5 April 2027, so on-call teams need a new home for their alerts.

## What should I list first?

Write down every alert that pages a person today, and who gets it.

## In what order should I move them?

Move the alerts that wake people first. Test each one with a real phone before the next.

## When can I switch the old tool off?

After a full week with no missed page.

## What to do next

[Try M91: send your first alert in a few minutes.](https://m91-site.embarko.app/)
